title: Asymmetric Cost Behavior and Dividend Policy

scopes.description: Supplied mixed Stata/SAS workflow that prepares annual Compustat variables, estimates quarterly cost stickiness and runs baseline Table 3 with two reghdfe specifications, then writes the final firm identifier list.

requirements.description: Compustat annual input used both as compa_all.dta in Stata and COMP.COMPA_ALL in SAS. Actual source fields include gvkey/datadate/sich/sic plus fyear, at, mkvalt, csho, prcc_f, xrd, dvc, oibdp, ppegt, ppent, dltt, dlc, capx, txdb, ceq, pstkrv, prstkc, ib, dp, seq, dvp, che, invt, emp, aqc, aqs, rect, sale, state, ibcom, xint, txt, act, lct, idit, dvpsx_f, ajex, spi and curcd. The readable COMP.FUNDA candidate covers the financial/fiscal fields and sich but not sic/state; author export mapping and annual-history coverage remain unresolved. The datasheet-reported download dates are provenance context only; a compatible current product can be used.

routes.description: Readable common North America annual fundamentals candidate. Its native schema omits sic and state required by the source import; COMP.COMPANY has current gvkey/sic/state fields but no supplied historical join. The one-row read establishes field/readability evidence only; author export mapping and annual-history coverage remain unverified. Matching the datasheet download dates is not a run prerequisite.
routes.expected_period: Table 3 fyear 1978–2016 plus annual t+1 for f_DPS (through 2017), ROAVol history through at least CoreEarn fyear 1975 and prior assets fyear 1974, an asreg 16-year rolling fyear window with lagged CoreEarn (earliest range about 1963, possibly one prior year at the boundary), and up to 60 subsequent annual rows per GVKEY for the pre-filter SICH fill; complete candidate coverage and exact usable history remain unverified.

requirements.description: Compustat quarterly input read as compq in SAS WORK. It must include gvkey, datadate, fyearq, fqtr, fyr, datacqtr, datafqtr, saleq, xsgaq, atq, cogsq, oiadpq and xrdq. The readable COMP.FUNDQ candidate has these fields, but complete history and per-firm quarter coverage remain unverified. The datasheet-reported download dates are provenance context only; a compatible current product can be used.

routes.description: Readable common North America quarterly fundamentals candidate with all native columns selected in SAS Step 1. The one-row read establishes field/readability evidence only; complete firm-level history is not established. The supplied SAS call uses WORK.COMPQ, so an explicit alias/staging step is required. Matching the datasheet download dates is not a run prerequisite.
routes.expected_period: For each annual datadate, input quarterly rows with num_qtr distance 0–20; Stata log-change variables require preceding-quarter values, and SAS Step 3 retains order_q_dist 0–15 (16 quarters, consistent with t−3 through t). Table 3 final sample uses fyear 1978–2016; actual per-firm first quarter, date alignment and complete history unverified.

issues.description: The author code requires sic as a fallback when sich is missing and keeps state in its annual import. The local readable COMP.FUNDA table lacks both fields. COMP.COMPANY has gvkey/sic/state columns but is a current company dimension without datadate/fyear, and no join or temporal field-mapping rule is supplied. Do not remove source fields or silently assume the company-table join.

The bounded probes verify candidate readability and columns, not complete annual/quarterly coverage. The target’s annual construction needs a t+1 DPS lead, ROAVol lags and prior assets, a 16-year asreg rolling window on CoreEarn/lag_earn, and the pre-filter 60-row future SICH fill; quarterly construction joins through 20 quarters earlier and uses lagged quarterly fields for a 16-quarter regression window. Full history and per-firm coverage remain unresolved. The datasheet reports May 2017 and April 2020 downloads as provenance context, but current compatible products may be used and matching those pulls is not a prerequisite.

The single .do file interleaves Stata and SAS. SAS WORK.COMPA_Q must be exported/imported as compa_q.dta before Stata Step 2; Stata compa_q1.dta must be imported as SAS WORK.COMPA_Q1; SAS WORK.B_DEC_16 must be exported/imported as b_dec_16.dta before the final Stata merge. The source contains no directory/library setup or bridge commands. These are known workflow-preparation steps; the result table itself is not explicitly written to a table file, so capture both regressions in the batch log.

SAS PROC SORT line 207 uses `desending`, which is not the documented DESCENDING keyword. The preceding SAS/Stata stage creates compa_q1 from the listed fields and does not create a desending variable. Correct this spelling in the working copy to preserve the intended order_q_dist sort.

The provided SAS startup probe fails with a TKELS initialization error, so Base SAS and SAS/STAT PROC REG capability could not be verified in this environment. This is an unresolved initialization/runtime state, not evidence of a missing license.

evidence.description: The annual industry preparation fills missing SICH from the next sorted row within GVKEY.
evidence.quote: by gvkey: replace sich=sich[_n+1] if missing(sich) & !missing(sich[_n+1])

evidence.description: Annual variables include lagged assets/earnings, a t+1 DPS lead, ROA lags through l3ROA, and rolling asreg persistence.
evidence.quote:
gen CoreEarn=ib+0.6*xint-0.6*idit
sort num_gvkey fyear
by num_gvkey: gen lag_at=l.at
by num_gvkey: gen lag_earn = l.CoreEarn
gen DPS=dvpsx_f/ajex 
by num_gvkey: gen f_DPS=f.DPS
gen ROA=CoreEarn/lag_at
gen l1ROA=l.ROA
gen l2ROA=l2.ROA
gen l3ROA=l3.ROA
egen n=rownonmiss(ROA l1ROA l2ROA l3ROA)
egen ROAVol=rowsd(ROA l1ROA l2ROA l3ROA) if n==4
gen SI=spi/lag_at
generate LOSS=.
replace LOSS=1 if CoreEarn<0
replace LOSS=0 if CoreEarn>=0
replace LOSS=. if CoreEarn==.
bys num_gvkey: asreg CoreEarn lag_earn, wind(fyear 16) min(4)
rename _b_lag_earn Persist
drop _Nobs _R2 _adjR2 _b_cons n

evidence.description: The annual block merges its generated industry file, filters financial utilities and USD, then saves the Table 3 annual intermediate.
evidence.quote:
merge 1:1 gvkey datadate using compa_sich, keepusing(sich_num sich_string) /* compustat industry info, generated above */
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge
gen sic3=substr(sich_string,1,3)
gen flag_fu=1 if 4900<=sich_num & sich_num<=4949      
replace flag_fu=1 if 6000<=sich_num & sich_num<=6999 
replace flag_fu=0 if missing(flag_fu)
keep if flag_fu==0
keep if curcd=="USD"
rename num_gvkey gvkey_n
sort gvkey_n datadate
save compa_from_Huan_final_JAR.dta, replace

evidence.description: The supplied file embeds SAS Step 1: annual and quarterly inputs are joined by GVKEY over the stated num_qtr distance.
The SAS annual-quarterly join output is sorted before the Stata handoff.
Stata Step 2 consumes compa_q.dta, constructs the quarterly distance and date keys, and groups annual firm dates.
evidence.quote:
use compa_q.dta, clear
gen order_q_dist= num_qtr - num_qtrq
drop if missing( order_q_dist)
gen datadate_qdate=quarterly( datacqtr ,"YQ")
replace datadate_qdate=qofd(datadateq) if missing(datacqtr)
format datadate_qdate %tq
egen gvkey_datadate=group(gvkey datadate)

evidence.description: Stata Step 2 preserves the author’s duplicate screening and hardcoded gvkey_datadate/fyr rule.
evidence.quote:
drop if missing(datacqtr)
drop tag
duplicates tag gvkey_datadate datadate_qdate, gen(tag)
tab tag
browse if tag==1
browse if gvkey_datadate==392684
drop if gvkey_datadate==392684 & tag==1 & fyr==12
drop tag

evidence.description: Stata constructs quarterly log changes and saves compa_q1.dta for the next SAS stage.
evidence.quote:
xtset gvkey_datadate datadate_qdate ,quarterly
gen ch_lg_xsgaq=ln(xsgaq)-ln(l.xsgaq)
gen ch_lg_cogsq=ln(cogsq)-ln(l.cogsq)
gen ch_lg_oc=ln(saleq-oiadpq)-ln(l.saleq-l.oiadpq)
gen ch_lg_cost=ln(cogsq+xsgaq)-ln(l.cogsq+l.xsgaq)
gen ch_lg_saleq=ln(saleq)-ln(l.saleq)
gen dec=1 if saleq-l.saleq<0
replace dec=0 if saleq-l.saleq>=0
gen dec_ch_lg_saleq=dec*ch_lg_saleq
gen dec1=1 if saleq-l.saleq<0
replace dec1=0 if saleq-l.saleq>0
saveold compa_q1.dta ,replace

evidence.description: The embedded SAS Step 3 filters the 16-quarter window, runs PROC REG, and creates b_dec_16.
The PROC SORT statement contains the token `desending` before order_q_dist.
The final Stata section merges the annual intermediate with b_dec_16 and applies the authored fyear window.
evidence.quote:
use compa_from_Huan_final_JAR, clear
gen year=year(datadate)
merge 1:1 gvkey datadate using b_dec_16,keepusing(b b_dec n)
drop if _m==2
drop _merge
replace b_dec=b_dec*(-1)
replace b_dec=. if n<16
drop n
drop year
rename fyear year
sort gvkey_n year
xtset gvkey_n year, yearly
egen sic3_year=group(sic3 year)
keep if year>=1978 & year<=2016

evidence.description: The baseline Table 3 section winsorizes specified controls and runs two reghdfe models.
evidence.quote:
foreach var in f_DPS b_dec lnsize_at lev q cashholding ppeta ROA ROAVol SI Persist {
winsor `var', gen(w`var') p(0.01)
}
gen neg_wSI=-wSI

set more off
unab control: wlnsize_at wlev wq wcashholding wppeta wROA wROAVol LOSS neg_wSI wPersist

reghdfe wf_DPS wb_dec `control', noabsorb cluster(gvkey_n)
keep if e(sample)
reghdfe wf_DPS wb_dec `control', a(sic3_year) cluster(gvkey_n)

review_notes: The entire supplied 256-line source was read. Despite its .do extension and a static language inventory that lists only Stata, the source interleaves Stata and SAS preparation, regression and merge stages; it is substantive code, not a no-code release.
The two package-specific semantic_prechecks files were used as discovery leads only. Independent counting of cached source lines 12–71 confirms 60 repeated SICH-fill passes, not 70.

The only assessed target is the supplied baseline Table 3 workflow. The datasheet also mentions union election sources, but this supplied code does not read them; no union-data requirement is added. The appendix reports Tables A1–A7 without a corresponding supplied code branch.

The packaged identifier_gvkey.dta and streamed identifier_gvkey.txt contain firm keys only, as the datasheet says; they are final outputs/lookup data, not a prepared analysis panel or an analysis-only route.

The two regression results are not written to a table file in the supplied program; the future host batch run should capture the Stata log for review. The source’s hardcoded duplicate-resolution rule is preserved without firm/year substitution.

A readable local Compustat candidate is treated as an available route candidate without a separate current-entitlement/author-approval prerequisite. Its unresolved annual fields and full history remain explicit. The datasheet-reported May 2017 and April 2020 downloads are provenance context for later output comparisons, not required source matches; compatible current products can be used.
